attribution: TerraGoat is Bridgecrew's vulnerable-by-design Terraform, used here as a held-out set. It is not vendored.

pairs.why: TerraGoat tags do not include data_classification.
TerraGoat tags do not include a NordPay owner.
Locations are var.location (default East US). The policy does not evaluate variables and fails closed.
The vault is not tagged confidential, so this NordPay rule does not apply.
There is a wildcard custom role and no Owner role assignment.
Nothing is tagged environment=prod as a literal.
The backup rule only applies when a data resource is tagged prod.
There is no Log Analytics workspace. The short retention is on a log profile, covered by CKV_AZURE_37.

note: Ground truth was read from terraform/azure at that commit, before scoring. Technical rows are the adopted Checkov rules. NordPay rows are our Rego policies, which TerraGoat was never written to satisfy; they are reported separately so a missing tag is not counted as a TerraGoat detection.

pairs.why: The storage account never sets enable_https_traffic_only.
min_tls_version is not set on the storage account.
allow_nested_items_to_be_public is not set to false.
azurerm_storage_account_network_rules sets default_action to Deny.
The network rule bypasses Metrics, not AzureServices.
storage.tf uses GRS, which the check allows, but mssql.tf security_storage_account sets account_replication_type to LRS. One failing account fails the rule.
Queue logging sets read and delete to false.
The Key Vault does not set purge_protection_enabled.
Purge protection is unset, so the vault is not recoverable.
soft_delete_enabled is unset. This check treats a missing attribute as a pass.
public_network_access_enabled is unset and there is no network ACL.
The NSG allows TCP 22-22 from *.
The NSG allows TCP 3389-3389 from *.
app-service1 sets https_only to false.
app-service1 sets min_tls_version to 1.1.
Neither app service sets ftps_state.
app-service1 has no auth block and app-service2 sets auth enabled to false.
Neither app service configures HTTP logs.
remote_debugging_enabled is unset and this check treats that as a pass.
The custom role sets actions to *.
The activity log profile retains 30 days.
